description: Emits a typed frontend client from a published manifest's accepts/emits/errors, so a frontend consumes the exact pinned contract a server serves. Pure text generation: reads a digest-pinned published-manifest artifact, writes an inert client-source artifact. Makes no capability decision, holds no ambient authority, and executes nothing it generates (§30).
